identity description: A small paper seed packet. Cream paper envelope with the top folded over, a simple drawing of a green two-leaf sprout printed on the front, three round brown seeds spilling out at the corner.
A small round metal watering can. Leaf green body, a long thin spout pointing left ending in a brass sprinkler rose, an arched handle on top, one small cream highlight band.
A small terracotta flower pot with a thick rim, dark brown soil, and a young sprout with two round leaf-green leaves and one tiny curled new leaf.
A pair of cotton gardening gloves lying one over the other. Cream fabric with leaf green ribbed cuffs and small terracotta palm patches, fingers slightly curled.
A chubby round little cactus in a small painted terracotta pot. Leaf green body with vertical ribs and tiny cream spine dots, one pink flower on top.

A garden wind chime. A round wooden disc on top with a hanging loop, five brass tubes of different lengths hanging on thin strings, and a small leaf-shaped wooden sail hanging in the middle below them.

A round glass terrarium bowl with a brass rim at the opening. Inside: little moss hills, a small fern, a tiny red-capped mushroom and two pebbles. The glass is drawn with simple pale blue tint and two hard white highlights.
A plump golden pumpkin with deep rounded ribs, a short curly green stem with one leaf and a curly vine tendril. Brass gold body with darker gold in the ribs and cream highlights.
